description.en: Adds a Tasks kanban tab next to Chat and Trajectory in the DSH Desktop conversation header, with drag-to-execute task cards that create real agent sessions bound to each task working directory.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 会话头部新增与对话、轨迹并列的任务看板页签，支持三栏 Kanban 与拖拽触发、按工作目录创建真实 Agent 会话执行任务。
